thread:
Asha (partnerships): PolarisCompute preview confirmed for next week (Mon arrival). Need: signed NDA, customs clearance, bench acceptance criteria, and a short go/no-go checklist. Also include marketplace listing checklist for later. Who owns what? cc @Tom @Ravi @Lina @Gabe @Maya
Tom (partner-ops): I can handle shipping and customs. Partner ships DDP but wants us to provide rack slot and PDU mapping. Need declared value for customs and HS codes. Also asked about on-site SI integration window for partner SIs.
Ravi (hw-eng): HW notes: 3 nodes (1U each), power 1.5kW sustained per rack. Firmware images: polaris-2026-06a (stable) and polaris-2026-06b (perf). Recommend run stable first, then perf image. Need serials + checksum on arrival and PCIe layout diagram.
Lina (bench): I'll own bench validation. Proposed minimal matrix: single-stream latency (seq=8192), batch8 throughput (tokens/sec), and a 12h soak. Also a 500-sample quality sweep vs redwood/v1.2. Acceptance: p99 within 10% and quality delta <0.8%. Add a micro-benchmark to isolate quant kernel timing.
Asha (partnerships): Also we should capture marketplace readiness checklist: AMI/container packaging, license/marketplace SKU, pricing tier, and a short SI integration doc. Maya, can marketing prep a joint announcement playbook after sign-off?
Maya (marketing): Yep. We'll prepare a press-playbook but will hold messaging until bench + legal sign-off and marketplace listing is approved. Need embargo window confirmation from legal. Also request partner logo + short 1-paragraph quote.
Gabe (legal): NDA draft received. Redlined telemetry, embargo, and marketplace disclosure items. Specifically: telemetry carveouts, KMS/HSM obligations for private deployments, and export control language. Requested countersign by Tue EOD. Also asked partner to acknowledge we will not share raw customer payloads with third parties.
Lina (bench): Runner snippet for infra to validate metrics export:
```bash
./run_bench --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 8192 --batch 1 --quant int8 --report s3://redwood-preview/polaris/metrics.json
```
We'll capture token-level latencies, p50/p95/p99, and perf traces (perfcollector) for later charts.
Ravi (hw-eng): If partner image polaris-2026-06b includes new kernels, capture dmesg, lspci, and /proc/modules. If we see PCIe reassignments, note mapping and test with passthrough.
Tom (partner-ops): Shipping labels ready. Carrier ETA Mon 18:00. Uploaded commercial invoice and HS codes to the shared drive. I'll also flag customs for potential export-license check since partner flagged some crypto acceleration on board.
Asha (partnerships): Good call on export control. Gabe, please coordinate with security on crypto accel disclaimers and any license needs for marketplace.
Gabe (legal): Will loop in security and export counsel. Also requesting KMS attestation from partner for marketplace images (if they expect private deployments).
Maya (marketing): For the joint announcement playbook, we need: embargo window, approved quote, approved perf table, and a single-sentence customer problem statement. Will draft once legal confirms embargo.
InfraBot: Calendar event created: "PolarisCompute Preview - Lab Week" Mon-Fri. Invitees: Asha, Tom, Ravi, Lina, Gabe, Maya.
Lina (bench): Potential blocker: quant path in polaris-2026-06b uses a different GEMM kernel which may reorder token timing. I'll run a micro-bench to compare token timing vs polaris-2026-06a and flag any >5% variability.
Ravi (hw-eng): If we find kernel differences, we'll request the vendor provide a stable kernel patch or fallback image. We'll log firmware+kernel+driver versions in feedback doc.
Tom (partner-ops): Partner asked about SI integration slot: they propose Thu afternoon for remote SI workshop. Can we confirm?
Asha (partnerships): Ok tentatively Thu 14:00. Tom, block 14:00-16:00 and invite SI leads. We'll keep it remote unless hardware issues force onsite.
Gabe (legal): NDA countersigned by partner? Partner counsel asked for minor telemetry clarifications; they agree to embargo 21 days after public sign-off. I'll upload signed copy when available.
Lina (bench): Uploading bench doc draft and runner to the shared drive now. Will include a feedback template: perf summary table, infra issues, firmware notes, action items with owners, go/no-go recommendation.
Asha (partnerships): Action items recap: Gabe - finalize NDA + export check by Tue; Tom - confirm shipping + customs and SI slot by Mon; Ravi - firmware/kernel capture + PCIe checks by Wed; Lina - bench runner + feedback doc by Mon AM; Maya - prepare draft announcement playbook pending legal. I'll run day-zero sync Mon 09:00.
Tom (partner-ops): Posted tracking and rack slot in the drive. Carrier updated ETA Mon 17:45.
Maya (marketing): Adding comms and marketplace PMs to the separate announcement thread. We'll collect the partner logo + short quote.
Asha (partnerships): Thanks team. Keeping this thread for coordination and day-zero items. :rocket:
